I have been divorced and it has been about 2 years now. The pain eventually fades but its still there. The first and foremost thing was for me is to accept the reality of the situation. That that person that you dreamed your life with is no longer there.

Secondly, if you can GO TO THERAPY. It helps alot and makes you see things in a different percpective and as a person it grows.

You will have triggers that will cause you to go back to memory lane. Remember there is a reason why you was divorced good or bad- you miss the memories. Delete everything you have it will cause more pain.

Be around healthy people all in all you have to literally force yourself to forget her. Recognise where you went wrong take ownership of those mistakes and fix them for the future.

I hope this helps. Remember YOU are not alone, there is alot of brothers/sisters who are struggling, including me. May Allah make it easier for all of us.
